name: Jeremiah
summary: A prophet from a priestly family in Anathoth whom the LORD called while he was young to speak His words to Judah and the nations. He warned of the fall of Jerusalem for many years and was beaten, imprisoned and thrown into a dungeon for it.

key_moments.title: Called as a Child
key_moments.description: The LORD told Jeremiah He had known him and set him apart as a prophet before he was born. When Jeremiah said he was only a child, the LORD touched his mouth and put His words there.

key_moments.title: Sent to the Potter's House
key_moments.description: The LORD sent Jeremiah to watch a potter remake a spoiled clay pot into another. He said Israel was in His hands just as clay is held by a potter.

key_moments.title: Buying a Field
key_moments.description: While Jeremiah was shut in the prison court, he bought his cousin's field in Anathoth and sealed the deed before witnesses. The LORD said that houses, fields and vineyards would one day be owned in the land again.

key_moments.title: Lowered into a Dungeon
key_moments.description: The princes lowered Jeremiah on cords into a dungeon with no water, and he sank in the mud. Ebedmelech the Ethiopian asked the king for help, and with thirty men he drew Jeremiah up with ropes and old rags.

key_moments.title: Taken to Egypt
key_moments.description: After Jeremiah told the people the LORD's word not to go to Egypt, the leaders said he was lying. They took all who were left, Jeremiah and Baruch too, and went to Tahpanhes in Egypt.
